g.text: 01 / NEATMAIL
Production SaaS that labels Gmail and Outlook inboxes in real time with AI. Live at neatmail.app, 145 stars.
Bulk unsubscribe, AI draft replies you approve from Telegram, encrypted PII, and corrections fed back as few-shot examples.
NEXT.JS · TYPESCRIPT · PYTHON · OPENAI · PINECONE · PRISMA · REDIS · BULLMQ · GMAIL API · GRAPH API
02 / VALUEFLOW NEXUS
Multi-tenant consulting SaaS that maps a client's operations across 17 analysis lenses. Freelance, private repo.
Streaming AI chat over the whole ValueMap. Prompt caching cut a follow-up question from $0.085 to $0.010.
NEXT.JS · TRPC · HONO · POSTGRESQL · DRIZZLE · ROW-LEVEL SECURITY · BULLMQ · REDIS · CLERK
03 / ADAPTIVE RAG
LangGraph agent that sends each query to document retrieval, Tavily web search, or a direct LLM answer.
Grades what it retrieves and rewrites weak queries before generating. FastAPI backend, MongoDB chat history.
PYTHON · LANGGRAPH · LANGCHAIN · FASTAPI · FAISS · GPT-4O · TAVILY · MONGODB · STREAMLIT
04 / UNASKED
Scope-drift detector for coding agents. Did the change stay inside what you asked for?
Tags every changed file as in-scope, derived, or drift, and blocks the turn when drift is risky. 448 tests, zero deps.
PYTHON · CODING AGENTS · ZERO DEPENDENCIES · ZERO MODEL CALLS
05 / RELAY
Shares a terminal, including a live Claude Code session, into someone else's terminal byte for byte.
Watch-only or collaborative with live cursors. Sessions record to disk, so people can replay them or join from a browser.
PYTHON · ONE FILE · ZERO DEPENDENCIES · XTERM.JS
06 / PIXELCAT
A pixel cat that lives on your desktop, follows your cursor, and knows when your AI agent is thinking.
Pomodoro headband, water reminders, yarn when you scroll. Zero network calls. Builds for macOS, Windows and Linux.
JAVASCRIPT · ELECTRON · DESKTOP
07 / PROJECT AVLOKAN
NSUT's certificate management and access control platform. 10K+ users, 7K+ certificates verified.
Role-based dashboards for students, faculty and admins, CSV bulk upload and export, and a manual verification flow.
REACT · TYPESCRIPT · TAILWIND CSS · TANSTACK QUERY · AOAA COMMITTEE, NSUT
08 / RESONANZE
Voice health tool that predicts likely conditions from a 5-second voice sample with 90% precision.
A TensorFlow classifier feeds a Groq LLM that writes the health report, on the web and in a Telegram bot.
REACT · NODE.JS · EXPRESS · MONGODB · FLASK · TENSORFLOW · GROQ
